items.note: soispoke 继续提交 EIP-8250：澄清 NONCE_MANAGER 激活，要求其地址不同于 8141 的 `EXPIRY_VERIFIER`，激活前出现代码或存储则激活区块无效；以及 EIP-8272：澄清签名哈希与预部署地址。
items.note_en: Soispoke also submitted EIP-8250: clarify NONCE_MANAGER activation, requiring its address to differ from 8141's `EXPIRY_VERIFIER` and making the activation block invalid if code or storage appears there before activation, and EIP-8272: clarify signature hashing and predeploy address.

keywords_en: unshield and swap in one ERC-4337 UserOp
summary_en: kassandraETH released a Kohaku CLI privacy demo on mainnet; per Ethereal news #32, it can unshield funds from Tornado Cash and swap in one ERC-4337 operation, and it is a work in progress without a security review. She also listed the only two HTTP endpoints the CLI talks to: the RPC and Pimlico's public bundler. EIP-8272 (recent root references) was listed as a Hegotá PFI. ACDT #88 was held in the evening; per Ethereal news #32, devnet-7 is in chaos testing and stable containers are about 10% to 20% slower.
